versions.changelog: Ownership moved to the trustgrowth org; content unchanged
Ownership migrated to the techwright org; content unchanged from 1.0.0

- Initial release of the grow skill, orchestrating the full Groundcrew growth loop (survey, fix, verify, report) or a single named phase via the --phase option.
- Integrates and coordinates other Groundcrew skills without adding its own data sources.
- Enforces evidence standards and reporting formats, requiring checks before using collected data in conclusions.
- Introduces strict phase boundaries, owner intervention gates before non-reversible or outward-facing changes, and clear stopping points between phases.
- Designed for full-site growth cycles, not single-surface questions or content publishing.
- Adheres to WHY-NOT-SLOP and ETHICS principles: all claims trace to evidence, owner review for impactful actions, and refusal of conflicting instructions.
